public_rationale: The record does not securely establish the dated pullback Marcus states. The original announcement was a staged intention to invest up to $100 billion. The prominent walkback remarks predate the target week, while Huang said on February 3 that the investment plans remained on track. That denial is contrary evidence, but does not settle private negotiations. Reports of a smaller single-round investment cannot establish a reduction of the whole plan.
limitations: The original CNBC transcript was not readable; Reuters reporting was used.
The dating of 'last week' is ambiguous.
The investment's private terms were not established.
The judgment that this was a 'terrible signal' is not separately scored.

public_payload.normalized_proposition: Last week (relative to the 2026-02-13 post), Nvidia pulled back on a $100 billion pledge to OpenAI, which Marcus calls a terrible signal to other potential investors.

statement.excerpt: More than that, last week Nvidia pulled back on a pledge of $100 billion, a terrible signal to other potential investors.

from_speaker: a terrible signal to other potential investors
our_interpretation: 'Last week' primarily means the preceding calendar week, February 2–8, 2026. A rolling February 6–12 reading is also plausible.
'Pledge' is read as the announced intention to invest up to $100 billion, not necessarily an enforceable contract.
'Pulled back' requires a material retreat from that overall intention. A smaller investment in one funding round does not establish a reduction in a multi-stage investment plan.
'A terrible signal' is Marcus's evaluation. The graded factual core is whether the pullback occurred; no separate investor-behavior forecast is inferred.
The amount refers to Nvidia's own announced investment intention, so the accounting basis is company_reported. No deployment or accounting period for the total amount is specified.
criteria.support_condition: A dated company statement, document, or well-corroborated report establishes that Nvidia materially reduced, suspended, or abandoned the overall announced investment intention during the target week.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Reliable records establish that the overall intention remained materially unchanged during the target week, or that the alleged retreat occurred outside that period.
